description:
Invoke function getAllEnterpriseInteractions

TIP: Gets ALL Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions for a SPECIFIC user — user prompts + Copilot responses across all integrated apps. Same shape as get-all-copilot-interactions but scoped to {aiUser-id} (which is the user's directory id / object id). Supports $filter, $top (recommended 100), date ranges. PRIVACY CAVEAT: scoping reduces but does not eliminate the surveillance impact — admin reads of a user's AI prompts must be documented per PIPEDA / Loi 25 / RGPD. PREFERRED over the tenant-wide variant when investigating a specific user (more efficient + less data over the wire).

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: get-user-copilot-interactions
